description: This file defines the PersistableOrder class, which extends OrderEntity and implements Serializable. It models an order in an e-commerce system, linking to customer information and order items.

classes.name: PersistableOrder
classes.description: A serializable class representing an order, containing customer details, order items, and shipping preferences.

methods.name: setOrderProductItems
methods.description: Sets the list of product items associated with this order.

methods.name: getOrderProductItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of product items associated with this order.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a customer with this order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: isShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Indicates whether the order is to be shipped to the billing address.

methods.name: setShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Sets whether the order should be shipped to the billing address.
